subject: SOC 2 re-attestation, log sampling plan & capacity uplift discussion
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco@cloudprocure.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal and logs retention window

Hi Mina,

We're starting our renewal workstream for Acme's contract (end date: 2026-12-31) and our security team has two items that need clarification before we sign the extension:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation — we need confirmation of whether Redwood will perform a re-attestation or provide an updated bridge letter for the coming 12-month period. If re-attestation is planned, what is the expected timeline and what artifacts you will provide?

2) Audit logs / retention — current contract references a 90-day logs window. Our auditors are asking for a sample of production audit logs (anonymized) and confirmation of the maximum retention configurable per account. We are also evaluating increasing our ingestion capacity by ~2x, which could affect log volume.

Please find attached our current audit scope for reference (attachment: current_audit_scope.pdf). Can we get a short plan by EOD next Tuesday (Nov 24) so we can align with procurement?

Thanks,
Julia Park
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp

---
Sent from my laptop
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal and logs retention window

Hi Julia — thanks for the heads up and the scope doc. Looping in Ben (AE) and Sean (Security) and Laura (Renewals) to confirm.

Quick summary of our proposed approach:
- SOC 2: We intend to provide a re-attestation (full SOC 2 Type II) within the renewal window unless you elect to accept a bridge letter plus a targeted control summary. Typical timeline for a full re-attestation is 10–12 weeks from calendar start; a bridge letter can be delivered within 2 weeks.
- Audit artifacts: we can provide anonymized log samples and a log-sampling report. See attachment: soc2-renewal-checklist.xlsx (we'll populate this and share by Nov 24).
- Retention: account-level configurable retention currently supports 30/90/365 day windows; we can propose a contractual uplift to 365 days for enterprise plans — this requires a capacity amendment (pricing note below).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm capacity/pricing for 2x ingestion and 365-day retention.
2) Sean to outline what log artifacts we can safely provide and the anonymization process.
3) Laura to draft the term amendment language (retention & capacity) and share a redline.

We can sync briefly Monday (Nov 23) for 20 minutes if that helps — otherwise we'll route via email.

Attachments: soc2-renewal-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal and logs retention window

Mina / team — tagging in the technical details for Julia's auditors. Short version up front: we can provide anonymized samples and a sampling report that shows coverage across regions, namespaces, and retention windows. Important notes:

- What we can provide: request/response audit entries, auth events, admin actions, and deployment logs. All PII/identifiers can be hashed and truncated; we produce JSONL exports (attachment: log-sample-1.jsonl).
- Sampling approach: 7-day contiguous sample plus additional event-type stratified samples. We'll include a hash map and an explanation of the anonymization steps in the sampling report.
- Retention config: platform supports 30/90/365/540 day buckets; 365/540 require additional storage allocation and a capacity amendment for predictable throughput.
- Impact of 2x ingestion: expect ~1.9x increase in daily log volume depending on request mix; KV/cache behavior can reduce some tail amplification but we should assume linear increases for planning.

I'll prepare:
- A detailed sampling report for auditors (3–4 pages)
- A proposed anonymization checklist
- An estimate for the storage delta and any throughput/CPU impact tied to retention config

I can have the sampling report draft by Tue Nov 24 COB. If procurement needs a line-item storage estimate, Ben can pick that up.

--
Sean Gallagher
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marco Rossi <marco@cloudprocure.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Procurement: capacity uplift pricing & contract redline

Hi team — procurement here. Acme is prepared to move forward with a 24-month renewal if Redwood can: (a) agree to 365-day retention in the contract, (b) add capacity for ~2x ingestion, and (c) provide SOC 2 re-attestation or bridge letter within the first 90 days of the term.

Can you confirm pricing for the capacity uplift and send a draft redlined amendment? We prefer to receive the contract via DocuSign and require a PO number on the signed agreement. I've attached an initial redline from our legal team for your review (attachment: redline_v1.docx).

Also, auditors asked if log samples will include a date/time index formatted as ISO-8601 and whether event types are mapped to a standard taxonomy — please confirm.

Thanks,
Marco Rossi
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp (via CloudProcure)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Rossi <marco@cloudprocure.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal and logs retention window — action plan and timeline

Thanks, Marco / Julia — short update and confirmed next steps so procurement can proceed:

1) SOC 2 deliverable: Redwood will provide a bridge letter within 10 business days post-signature and begin re-attestation work immediately; full Type II report available within ~10–12 weeks from start. (Deliverable: bridge_letter_RD-6532.pdf — will be attached to the DocuSign envelope.)

2) Log samples & format: Sean confirmed we can provide anonymized JSONL samples with ISO-8601 timestamps and event-type mapping. We'll include the sampling report and anonymization checklist. Target delivery: Tue Nov 24 (sampling report draft) — completed and sent to Julia.

3) Retention & capacity: Ben will send a formal pricing line for 365-day retention + 2x ingestion as a capacity amendment. Preliminary estimate: +18% over current committed spend (final number after usage profile). Ben — action to produce a list-price vs. committed-discount comparison and add to the DocuSign amendment.

4) Contract & procurement: Laura will generate the redline response to your attached document and route to you via DocuSign. We'll ensure the DocuSign envelope includes the bridge letter and the retention amendment. Please provide the PO number once DocuSign is out.

5) Timeline: If we sign by Dec 7, bridge letter delivered Dec 9, re-attestation kickoff Dec 10, final report by end-Feb 2027.

Related links:
- Deal: https://app.redwood.ai/hubspot/deal/6532
- DocuSign (draft envelope): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/rd-6532-sign

We'll follow up with the populated SOC2 checklist and the contract redline/upload in the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
